resolution_notes: Both verifiers correctly flagged base_url: official SDK/docs use env-specific REST hosts (prod https://api.braintreegateway.com:443, sandbox https://api.sandbox.braintreegateway.com:443) plus separate GraphQL endpoints (payments.braintree-api.com / payments.sandbox.braintree-api.com). free_tier_limits was wrong on the quoted US card rate—official PayPal Braintree fees (updated May 7, 2026) list standard US cards at 2.89% + $0.29, not 2.59%+$0.49; free tier is sandbox-only with no free production quota. Other fields kept as original.
base_url: https://api.braintreegateway.com (prod REST); sandbox REST https://api.sandbox.braintreegateway.com; GraphQL https://payments.braintree-api.com/graphql (sandbox: https://payments.sandbox.braintree-api.com/graphql)
free_tier_limits: Sandbox free for full API testing; no free production transaction quota. US standard cards 2.89%+$0.29 (as of May 2026); rates vary by region/method — confirm official pricing
